metadataRaw.title: How to PULL OPEN Your Back for Instant Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to pull open your back for instant pain relief.

These exercises are going to be pulling motions, known as TRACTION or DECOMPRESSION. They focus on reducing pressure in the spinal discs of the lumbar spine, loosening up tight muscles... and giving quick pain relief.

This is especially good for anyone that is dealing with lower back pain (or sciatica leg pain) caused by a bulging or herniated disc. 

All of these exercises offer a DEEP pull into the lower back, and they all work a little bit differently. Make sure to go through them all and use what works best for you. As a bonus, they can all be done AT HOME.

Watch now and pull open your back for quick pain relief! 

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:31 Prone Leg Kick
3:30 Anywhere Back Opener
4:57 Soup Can Back Opener
8:01 Kitchen Sink Opener
